ambient_events: The shelving ticks under the weight of the tins.
The pen on its string swings very slightly, and stops.
description: A storage room with a hand-lettered sign on the door: ST GARNEAU'S FOOD PANTRY FOR THE POOR. Wire shelving, mostly tins, sorted by somebody who cared enough to face all the labels the same way. A clipboard hangs on a nail by the door with a sheet on it headed TAKEN, and a pen on a string, and the honour system written across the top in the same hand as every note upstairs. The most recent entries aren't in that hand and aren't entries.
name: St Garneau's Food Pantry
